party_and_bag.checksum_note: Three RAM captures (cold field and both post-ack fields) sample slot 2 at a checksum-invalid intermediate, but every byte matches the source record at an allowed two-byte encrypted/plain boundary; no normalized or semantic bypass was used.

limits: This verifies selector cancellation and selection of slot 0, not a production UI or EV/IV mutation.
There is no native save/cold-reload acceptance for selector results in this case.
Earlier candidates and their failed attempts remain preserved and are excluded from this hash-specific result.

summary.en: The exact isolated FIX6a candidate opens the native party selector; cancel returns VAR_SPECIAL_RESULT 255 and slot 0 returns 0. Both branches display their result message, then return to a clean visible field. Battery bytes, the full runtime Bag array, party contents at strict two-byte cipher boundaries, the new helper block, and the adjacent HM/shop/Repel reserve are verified. No stat setter is invoked.
summary.es: La candidata FIX6a aislada abre el selector nativo: cancelar devuelve VAR_SPECIAL_RESULT 255 y elegir la posición 0 devuelve 0. Ambas ramas muestran el resultado y vuelven al campo visible y limpio. Se verifican la batería, el array completo de la Bolsa en runtime, el equipo con fronteras cifradas estrictas de 2 bytes, el bloque del helper y la reserva HM/tienda/Repel contigua. No se invoca ningún setter de estadísticas.
